underlines.text: But she had no reason to fear Mr. and Mrs. Gardiner’s curiosity

reference.text: She retreated from the window, fearful of being seen; and as she walked up and down the room, endeavouring to compose herself, saw such looks of inquiring surprise in her uncle and aunt as made everything worse.

underlines.text: it was evident that he was very much in love with her

reference.text: Of the lady’s sensations they remained a little in doubt; but that the gentleman was overflowing with admiration was evident enough.
Since her being at Lambton, she had heard that Miss Darcy was exceedingly proud; but the observation of a very few minutes convinced her that she was only exceedingly shy.
